newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast products unchanged in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast products unchanged in thin trade.

text.p: HOUSTON, Jan 2 (Reuter) U.S. West Coast spot refined products prices were unchanged on Thursday in thin trade following the midweek New Year's Day holiday, traders said.
"I've heard nothing being done today," said one West Coast trader who saw another slow trading session ahead on Friday.
"It's very quiet," said another trader, who saw no impact from the weekly American Petroleum Institute refined products inventory report released late in the day.
The API said West Coast refineries for the week ended Dec. 27 were operated at 89.7 percent of capacity, down 0.5 percentage points from the prior week.

Gasoline inventories on hand at PADD V West Coast refineries were down 1.01 million barrels compared to the prior week, but remained 1.65 million barrels above the same week last year, the trade group said.
Low sulphur diesel stocks were unchanged and high sulphur stocks rose 257,000 barrels in the region, the API said in a weekly report delayed by Wednesday's holiday.

Traders earlier said Tosco Corp's 95,000 barrel-per-day Ferndale, Washington, refinery restarted late Tuesday after day-long shutdown due to power failures from weekend storms that battered the region.
